messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout started for api-inference v2.14.0 -> canary (us-west-2). Running post-deploy smoke suite now. Notify if you see anything odd.

maya: quick heads-up — our synthetic kv-prefill probe p95 jumped from ~110ms to ~430ms in us-west canary after the first wave. 3/10 probes failed.

alex: can you paste the failing probe logs? looks like a tokenizer spike in pod api-inference-2.14.0-3.

maya: logs attached in the diagnostics bucket, snippet below:```
[2026-03-23T09:12:07Z] kv-prefill: POST /prefill -> 502, backend=api-inference-2.14.0-3, err="tokenizer OOM while encoding prompt"
```

jordan: hmmm, only seen this on the canary subset in us-west. No failures in eu or apac canaries.

sam: I ran a quick local curl against the health endpoint for that pod:```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api-inference-2.14.0-3.us-west.internal/health | jq '.'
{
  "status": "degraded",
  "components": {"tokenizer": "error: OOM (32768MB)"}
}
```

sre-oncall: Recommend two immediate actions: 1) pin us-west routing back to v2.13.9 for traffic and halt further us-west waves; 2) open a rollback hold for the global rollout until we triage. :warning:

jordan: +1 to pin (less disruptive than full rollback) — we can continue elsewhere. Who can perform the pin now?

alex: I can put a routing override in for us-west. Will also add a temporary smoke threshold tweak to reduce noisy failures while we debug.

deploy-bot: Action logged: routing.pin applied -> region=us-west-2, target_version=2.13.9, actor=alex (3170000142). Smoke suite re-evaluating.

maya: After the pin, the canary in us-west stabilized; probe failures dropped to 0/10. p95 back to ~115ms.

sre-oncall: Good. Let's add a short postmortem note to the release notes: "us-west canary pin due to tokenizer OOM in v2.14.0; rollout resumed in other regions; investigation ongoing." Also flag the change window owner for follow-up.

jordan: Filed a quick follow-up ticket (ENG-9421) to reproduce locally with the same tokenizer config and investigate memory pressure. Assigning to @alex and @maya.

sam: small ops note: while pinning, we should also roll forward a quantized variant of v2.14.0 in a sandbox to validate memory usage before reattempting canary.

alex: tracked. I'll keep the global rollout paused for full canary until we validate a fix. tagging @release-manager for schedule update. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Closing the immediate incident — routing pin successful and canary in us-west held. Will update the release notes and add a scheduled reattempt after mitigation.

maya: thanks all. leaving the thread open for updates from ENG-9421 and the rollout owner. :ok_hand:
